name: familienplaner
description: Orchestrierungs-Skripte für Docker, Tests und Security-Scans. Kein eigenständiges Paket.

scripts.migrate: docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.migrate:new: docker compose exec backend alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.security: npm run security:backend && npm run security:frontend
scripts.security:backend: backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m bandit -c backend/pyproject.toml -r backend/app -q && backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip_audit -r backend/requirements.txt --ignore-vuln PYSEC-2026-1325
